tasks.title: Create the OSHA Establishment register
tasks.objective: Give the company a separate list of OSHA establishments for hours entry and regulatory reporting.
tasks.scope: Create the establishment register, its sixteen information fields, unique establishment codes, change history and administration screens in Safety Metrics. Connect its Type and Size selectors to the existing numeric choices and exclude Deleted=TRUE choices from new selection. Later tasks add related-Record lists and protect codes already in use.
tasks.deliverable: An establishment register with the specified fields, unique codes and administration screens.
tasks.rationale: The work uses standard field settings, a simple unique-code check and two administration screens. The more complex access rules have their own assignment.
steps: Create OSHA Establishment in Safety Metrics (E36). It must stand on its own, without a Location Structure connection, an inheritance base Object or a workflow. Set IsAbstract=FALSE and IsLocationBound=FALSE, and enable Intelex change history. Create OSHA Establishment detail screen and OSHA Establishment inventory screen; use Name as the Record's displayed label.

Require a unique Code of up to 100 characters and do not translate it. Start Active? at TRUE and use Name as the reporting name without translation. Connect EstablishmentType to the existing EHSIncidentMang_EstablishmeTypeObject and EstablishmentSize to EHSIncidentMang_EstablishmeSizeObject. Limit new selections to Deleted=FALSE, retain existing references if a choice is later deleted, and leave both inverse relationships disabled. Place the fields below on the administration screen. Company Name, Street, City, State and Postal Code can remain blank while an establishment is being maintained. The report tasks will require this information before producing a report.

Configure Establishment Type to use existing Value 1, "Establishment is not a government entity"; 2, "Establishment is a State Government entity"; and 3, "Establishment is a Local Government entity". Configure Establishment Size to use existing Value 1, "< 20 employees"; 2, "20-249 employees"; and 3, "250+ employees". Use the locally installed Records for those values rather than hard-coding source Record GUIDs. Do not automatically assign a size from headcount.

tasks.title: Set up shared hours entry and monthly summaries
tasks.objective: Let users enter hours once and maintain headcounts separately on the monthly summaries.
tasks.scope: Create Hours Worked and Establishment Hours and Headcount, their screens, native summary-hour calculations and related-entry grids. Change the existing location summary hours from direct inputs to calculated grid sums, retain editable headcounts and saved summary identity, and enable its change history. IMP-07 configures the source relationships that feed those calculations.
tasks.deliverable: Shared hours and monthly-summary fields/screens, four native SUM calculations, related-entry grids and retained summary-identity checks.
tasks.rationale: This assignment connects one entry screen to two kinds of monthly summary. A Consultant can keep their field settings, selection rules and screen behavior consistent.
steps: Create Hours Worked and Establishment Hours and Headcount in Safety Metrics (E36). Both allow their own Records, use no inheritance base Object, have no workflow and are not tied to Location Structure. Enable change history. Create Hours Worked detail screen, Hours Worked inventory screen, Establishment Hours and Headcount detail screen and Establishment Hours and Headcount inventory screen.

Use Source Entry ID (SourceEntryID) as the Hours Worked Record label and require it to be unique. Require Month to be the first day of a month, using DAY(Month)=1. Always show both Location and OSHA Establishment. Location is required when OSHA Establishment is blank; OSHA Establishment is required when Location is blank. Show the corresponding summary link when a selection is present. That link must be filled by the automatic update before the save finishes, rather than required before the update can run. Selecting or changing one reporting choice must not fill in or clear the other.

Show Employee Hours and Contractor Hours as separate required editable Float/System.Double fields, default 0, allowing zero and fractional hours and rejecting NULL, negative or nonfinite values. Configure EmployeeHrs on both monthly summaries as SUM(HoursWorkedEntries.EmployeeHours) and ContractrHrs as SUM(HoursWorkedEntries.ContractorHours). Each uses its own HoursWorkedEntries grid. Show these four calculated fields as read only, including API/import routes. Do not add a total-writing Action Handler or Delete handler; native grid calculations reflect entry create/edit/delete/relink. Headcounts remain independent editable inputs.

On the new establishment summary, allow only one Record for each OSHAEstablishment and Date, and require DAY(Date)=1. Add the proposed Protect Monthly Summary Identity check to both summary types: once saved, their location or establishment and Date cannot change, and a summary used by Hours Worked cannot be deleted. The existing location checks Unique Location-Date (E183) and Date on first of month (E80) already cover duplicate periods and first-of-month dates; use them without creating replacements.

Add the proposed Initialize Establishment Monthly Summary create Action Handler. When the summary is first created, copy OSHAEstablishment.Name into LocNameHelper and use Intelex automatic numbering for RecordNo. Later establishment name changes or deactivation must not replace the saved name. New headcounts start at zero; an update must never reset an existing headcount. This handler does not calculate hours or refresh reports. Use the existing Set Location Name Helper flow as evidence of the name-copy rule, not as proof of a create-event binding. The source handler has stable ID 5d1ff7d0-0a65-455f-a19b-8ab03332b0d9 and copies Location.Name only when AND(ISCHANGED(Location), NOT(Location.Deleted)). The new establishment handler must initialize LocNameHelper through the supplied supported create route; the location handler remains unchanged.

Allow authorized headcount-only monthly-summary creation with the required location or establishment and first-of-month Date; keep those saved selections fixed afterward. Initialize numbering, saved names and headcount defaults using native settings. Add each read-only Hours Worked Entries list as the inverse of the corresponding source summary link. Those same grids feed the native SUM calculations, without a second relationship or explicit hours-rebuild operation.

modifications.change: Enable change history on the existing Location Hours and Headcount Object by changing IsAuditEnabled from FALSE to TRUE. Its existing Location Structure access rules, links and Record identifier stay in place.

After the separately managed legacy-hours cutover and opening-entry reconciliation, change Employees Hours (EmployeeHrs) from IsReadOnly=FALSE and Calculation=NULL to a read-only native calculated field with SUM(HoursWorkedEntries.EmployeeHours). Keep its field GUID and Float/System.Double type. Show it as read only on SafetyMetrics_HrsandHeadcount_Detail (E209); users, APIs and imports cannot enter its value. Native calculation replaces direct hours entry.

After the separately managed legacy-hours cutover and opening-entry reconciliation, change Contractor Hours (ContractrHrs) from IsReadOnly=FALSE and Calculation=NULL to a read-only native calculated field with SUM(HoursWorkedEntries.ContractorHours). Keep its field GUID and Float/System.Double type. Show it as read only on SafetyMetrics_HrsandHeadcount_Detail (E209); users, APIs and imports cannot enter its value. Native calculation replaces direct hours entry.

The package declares Date with IsReadOnly=FALSE and a normal Date control. Allow its first-of-month selection when creating a summary, then make it read only after the first save. Keep its required setting and MonthStartValueGenerator default. Protect Monthly Summary Identity prevents later Date changes through other save routes.

Allow the required selection when creating a summary, then make it read only after the first save. Keep the existing location relationship and permissions. Protect Monthly Summary Identity prevents later Location changes through other save routes.

tasks.title: Set up establishment incident-rate records
tasks.objective: Store monthly incident measures for each establishment and let authorized users enter their rate targets.
tasks.scope: Create the Establishment Incident Rate Abstract and its concrete KPI Object, including twenty saved measures, establishment and month details, supporting fields and four editable targets. Add the screens and related KPI list on the establishment. Later tasks fill the measures and display the actual rates.
tasks.deliverable: The twenty-nine monthly/KPI fields, period checks, four screens and the establishment's related KPI list.
tasks.rationale: The source provides a defined set of fields and straightforward monthly checks. A Senior Associate Consultant can configure the shared definition and screens without taking on the calculation design.
steps: Create Establishment Incident Rate Abstract as an abstract Object that cannot hold Records. Create Establishment Incident Rate KPI as its direct concrete child. Put both in Safety Metrics (E36), set IsLocationBound=FALSE, enable change history and add no workflow. Define the shared fields once on the abstract Object and the four target fields only on the KPI Object.

Allow one Record per OSHAEstablishment and Date, and require DAY(Date)=1. Monthly generation supplies the establishment and month; users cannot reassign generated Records. Use RecordNo as an automatically numbered Record label with a new number sequence.

Create Establishment Incident Rate Abstract detail and inventory screens and Establishment Incident Rate KPI detail and inventory screens. Show RecordNo, OSHA Establishment and Date, then sections for editable targets, incident counts, lost days and employee/contractor hours. Show all saved measures as read only. Keep the field name TargetDART with the label Target DAIR. Hide LocationIdHelp on ordinary screens; it stores the establishment's unique Record identifier.

Build the new screens' field lists from the fields that actually exist on these two Objects. Leave out the source screen's obsolete DisplayField, Month, RepLocationId and missing OSHA-category fields. Add Incident Rate KPIs to the establishment screen using the KPI Object's existing OSHAEstablishment link; do not store a second link.
accept: Records can be created on the KPI Object, but not directly on its abstract definition; shared fields appear only once.
The four targets can be edited by authorized users and all twenty saved measures are read only.
A duplicate establishment/month or a date other than the first of the month is rejected.
Every new screen field exists, and TargetDART is displayed as Target DAIR.

tasks.title: Set up the shared annual OSHA fields
tasks.objective: Provide the annual case counts, day totals and saved establishment details needed for OSHA reporting.
tasks.scope: Create the shared annual OSHA definition with thirty-five fields, its January 1 and duplicate-Record checks, and its screens. Include the saved report header and link to the correct OSHA settings. IMP-09 fills the annual totals and copies the reporting details when a summary is created.
tasks.deliverable: Thirty-five annual fields, annual-period checks and two screens for the shared OSHA definition.
tasks.rationale: The field list and January 1 checks are defined. A Senior Associate Consultant can create the shared annual fields and screens; the separate annual-calculation task owns source-value population and the remaining case-helper decisions.
steps: Create Establishment OSHA Abstract in Safety Metrics (E36) as an independent abstract Object that cannot hold Records. Set IsAbstract=TRUE and IsLocationBound=FALSE, enable change history and add no workflow.

Allow one Record per OSHAEstablishment and Date. Require January 1 using AND(MONTH(Date)=1, DAY(Date)=1). Annual generation supplies the required establishment and date, shown read only. Use a new automatic number sequence for RecordNo and the Record label. ReporLocationId must hold the establishment's unique Record identifier, not a Location Structure identifier.

Create Establishment OSHA Abstract detail screen and Establishment OSHA Abstract inventory screen. Show the case counts, day totals, year, annual date, establishment and saved header fields as read only. Hide OIISettings on ordinary summary screens. Leave related-Record lists off on settings and classification Records. Include only fields that exist on the shared definition.

Add LocationName, LocationStreet, LocationCity, LocationState and LocationPostal as saved copies for the annual report header. Later master changes must not continuously rewrite them. Year is also a saved value filled by annual processing. This new definition must not inherit the original location-based OSHA Object or contain a Location reference.
accept: The twenty-four annual count/day fields exist once on the independent establishment definition.
Dates other than January 1 and duplicate establishment/year Records are rejected.
The annual Record keeps its own header values, and ReporLocationId holds the establishment identifier.
The settings link uses the supplied Record for the intended environment, or remains waiting for that information. It does not silently reuse the source environment's reference.

tasks.title: Set up annual OSHA summaries and case lists
tasks.objective: Give users an annual establishment summary with workforce figures, reporting details and access to the correct OSHA cases.
tasks.scope: Create the annual summary Object with seventeen additional fields, the shared annual fields, its screens and the related-summary list on the establishment. Add a read-only case list and OSHA 301 print link once the separate incident design supplies the required case links. Other report print links have their own tasks.
tasks.deliverable: Annual establishment summaries, seventeen additional fields, summary screens, the establishment's related-summary list and the OSHA case list.
tasks.rationale: A Consultant is needed to connect the shared annual fields to case information and case printing while preserving confidential employee details.
steps: Create Establishment OSHA Summary directly from Establishment OSHA Abstract in Safety Metrics (E36). Enable change history, leave it independent of Location Structure and add no workflow. Add only its seventeen additional fields; use the shared fields without redefining them.

Create Establishment OSHA Summary detail screen and Establishment OSHA Summary inventory screen with establishment/year details and sections for G–J cases, K/L days, M1–M6 injury/illness types and employment figures. Allow authorized edits to CompanyName, EINNumber, EstablishmeName, InduDescription, EstablishmeType, EstablishmtSize, AnyRecrdblIncid, OSHA300aID, EstablishmentID and ChangeReason. Other saved header/code corrections use the authorized annual-correction process. Hide OIISettings.

Add AssociatedOIIs as a read-only list of zero or more injury/illness Records through the separately supplied establishment-summary reference or query; do not create an incident field in this task or repoint the existing OII.OSHASummary location link. Configure the list to show each eligible OSHA case once through AssociatedOIIs.OSHARecord and InjuryIllnes.OSHARecordable=TRUE. tasks.title: Set up who can see and change information
tasks.objective: Give users the access they need without allowing a location or establishment selection to expose other information.
tasks.scope: Set user-group, Record and field access for all eight new or changed Objects. Check location and establishment access separately. Protect calculated hours, summary links, establishment codes already in use and restricted corrections. Apply the rules to screens, links and imports while retaining the existing incident-security rules.
tasks.deliverable: User access settings, protected fields and establishment codes, and the access check used when an hours entry contains either or both reporting choices.
tasks.rationale: A Senior Consultant is needed because an entry may involve two independent access rules and must not expose confidential incident or employee information.
steps: Connect the supplied user groups to their responsibilities: establishment administrators maintain establishments; hours editors add/change/delete permitted Hours Worked Records; headcount editors maintain summary headcounts; analytics administrators set KPI targets; regulatory administrators maintain annual reporting details and authorized corrections; reporting users see only permitted results. Prevent ordinary users, APIs and imports from writing summary EmployeeHrs/ContractrHrs or source LocationHoursHeadcount/EstablishmentHoursHeadcount directly.

Set the access check so Location-only entry requires access to that location, establishment-only entry requires access to that establishment, and an entry containing both requires both permissions. Recheck access when selections change. Opening a related Record must not grant access to the other reporting choice. Make this check available to the hours-update process; do not create a new security hierarchy.

Prevent users from changing SourceEntryID after creation. Restrict new assignments to inactive locations or establishments to the approved historical-correction role. Existing inactive assignments remain usable for authorized hours/month corrections and historical reporting. Only the authorized annual-header correction process may change its protected header fields.

Apply the same user-access rules through screens, direct Record URLs, search, exports and related-Record lists. Keep the original location summary's Location Structure access rules. Use the supplied independent rules for establishments and Hours Worked, while retaining existing case permissions and confidential-name handling.

Add the proposed Protect Establishment Code check and make Code read only once the establishment is used by Hours Worked.OSHAEstablishment, Establishment Hours and Headcount.OSHAEstablishment, Establishment Incident Rate KPI.OSHAEstablishment or Establishment OSHA Summary.OSHAEstablishment. Reject later code changes before saving, but allow Name to be updated. Prevent deletion of an establishment already in use and never delete its linked Records automatically. Setting Active? to FALSE must retain historical links.
accept: A user who has access to only one of the two selected reporting places cannot save an entry assigned to both.

Existing inactive assignments remain accessible as permitted without allowing everyone to make new inactive assignments.
An establishment already in use cannot have its Code changed or be deleted. Its Name can still change, and deactivation retains its history.

For the same establishment and calendar year, calculate annual employee hours and average employee headcount using the individual rules below. Fill AssociatedOIIs through the supplied establishment relationship/query, preserve the original location-summary link, and show each OSHA case only once.
